summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any tests or code, as instructed. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs with an (ndim, 2) integer coordinate array including the channel row; set_rnd skips keys starting with "__"); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter with ensure_tuple-normalised start_pos and a channel whole-dimension entry; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with lazy NotImplementedError for missing length, NumPy ceiling worker split, apply_transform with map_items=False; PatchDataset docstring float alias fixed; math import removed); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst gets a PatchIter autodoc entry; tests/test_grid_dataset.py added with test_shape, test_loading_array, and an extra test_missing_length. Choices to review: NotImplementedError raised in __iter__ rather than __init__; both test images set to np.arange(16, dtype=float).reshape(1, 4, 4) since the spec left values open; set_determinism called in setUp and again at the start of test_loading_array. Unverified: pinned expected values and the two-worker behaviour have not been checked by running pytest. Pre-existing docstring lines over 120 characters remain in get_valid_patch_size (utils.py lines 232-234), which I did not touch. No commits were made.
